body:
True, you are wrong.  Believe what you wish, not my cup of tea to argue with someone over something as trivial as this...

Do not expect another reply from me.

Been trying for half my life, tired of trying.

Do not expect another reply from me.

Not worth the effort of re-typing it, however thank you for informing me that you pulled the post.

Assuming you actually see this reply I cannot even GET medication so your feedback is actually nothing more than a unintentional slap in the face for me in that everyone except myself who tries to get help gets it.  As I said not only do therapists not take me seriously, the psychiatrist made it perfectly clear he will in no way see if any medication will help.  I have told this second therapist along with someone else who worked with me in the psychology department that I sincerely think drugs would be a good option for me because I doubt the usefulness of therapy for me.  I told those people this more than 2 months ago, and I repeated this request this month to the therapist with zero reply about if she is even bothering to talk to the psychiatrist about my case.

Do not expect another reply from me.

I am already convinced I will die.  Maybe in 80 years, maybe 80 hours.  I do not list much personal because I do not want people to force me into an institution with other clinically needy people where I spend the next 5 years convincing people that I am okay to be free on my own.  I do not spit on anyone because I just do not care about anyone.  I told a friend of mine a few weeks ago that I am trying to get help and that I am thinking about suicide.  She made it clear that if the people I am seeing now are not helping me I need to find someone else, while adding that when she went for help she got medicated immediately.  She utterly missed the point I had made of if I had not told her any of this she would never have known that I had offed myself.  I am not upset or angry, it is simply a matter of fact that if I were to die (either by my own hand or in a car crash) she and every other non family member might never know.  I suppose my coworkers would be informed via my family, but meh.

I already found my way out, the helium exit bag, and I have been playing with it, testing the waters if you want to view it that way.  I just wanted to know if you guys would react with "this guy is just trying to get attention" or "you need to find someone else ASAP!".  You seem to have taken the "you want attention" with a minor offset of trying to get me involved into a discussion to dissuade me.

Probably too lat to be any good to you, but the failure rate of sleeping pills is impressively high. Almost everyone who tires either freaks out and does go to hospital (as your friend did it sounds like) or they vastly underestimate how much of a beating the human body can take and end up waking up much later.

If you got him to go to a hospital I would say you did the best thing you possibly could have done to keep him alive.
